name: Sith Athara Histhan
overview: The story follows a group of interconnected characters who live together but feel deeply isolated from one another. It highlights how a lack of true communication, hidden secrets, and busy everyday routines build invisible walls between loved ones. As these secrets come to light, the characters must choose whether to break down their walls, face their vulnerabilities, and talk to each other, or let the growing silence permanently ruin their relationships.
